name: workbench
description: A complete process system for how work starts, gets designed, gets verified, and lands: user-sized audits, brainstorming that ends at your route pick (direct / plan / goal handoff), implementation discipline (TDD, systematic debugging, evidence-gated readiness), one adversarial review, and landing that files the PR and tends CI to green. Backed by five read-only review agents. Core process skills derived from obra/superpowers (MIT) — no hooks, no dispatcher; skills fire on relevance.

interface.shortDescription: The workbench flow for Codex — how work starts, gets designed, gets verified, and lands.
interface.longDescription: A Codex manifest for the Workshop workbench plugin. Codex exposes the file-pr, handoff-goal, claim-check, qa-sweep, empirical-proof, code-quality-review, get-pr-comments, route-work, and fix-ci skills plus the workbench process set (audit, brainstorming, test-driven-development, systematic-debugging, verification-before-completion, receiving-code-review, using-workbench, self-audit) from this package; the agent files (the reviewers plus ci-watcher) are bundled in the payload for Claude Code and reference, but Codex standalone custom agents still need repo-local .codex/agents wrappers.
defaultPrompt: How does the workbench flow work?
Audit something: size the workload, run the right engine, confirm the flags.
Investigate whether a ticket or claim still holds.
Brainstorm a feature or refactor design, ending at my route pick.
Hand the rest of this plan to a fresh session as a goal contract.
Run a strict code quality review on the current branch.
Run a team-scale QA sweep over a release and corroborate the findings.
Empirically prove a just-finished change at the running app.
Summarize the active PR's review comments into a prioritized action list.
Watch the current branch's CI and fix whatever breaks.
File the branch's PR and see it through to green and mergeable.
Look back over this session and audit the workbench process that ran it.
Look up the model × effort reference table for this work.
